thread:
Maria CSM: Heads up — ingest pipeline lag started at 02:10 UTC, affected onboarding and several renewal-touch accounts. Seeing delayed embeddings and 503s for batch ingest only. Working on customer-facing comms. Who can help prep segmented notices and enablement options? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0431. Current severity: P2. Link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-0431

Kevin (Infra): We're on it — root cause looks like a backing-store I/O stall related to a reindex job. I can throttle the job and push a hotfix to limit parallelism. ETA ~20m.

Nikhil (SRE): Confirming — I put a conservative circuit on the reindexer and cleared the backlog for high-priority tenants. Some batch jobs will retry; expect partial recovery in 10–15m and full in ~1h.

Olivia (CS Lead): Thanks. Maria, recommend we split customers into A) high-touch renewals (top 40 accounts) B) mid-tier onboarding (trial -> paid) C) low-impact. A needs immediate human outreach + exec note, B needs templated email + enablement office hours, C gets status page + queued follow-up.

Maria CSM: Agree. Drafts: short status email + expected impact + mitigation + offer 1:1 office hours & credit. I'll mock email — want a quick review.

Anya (Enablement): I can run two 30-min office hours slots today at 16:00 and 18:00 UTC and pull a one-pager on workaround prompts for embeddings. Also can add a short "how to verify reindex success" checklist.

Sam (Sales): For any accounts in renewal this quarter, I'll join outreach. Flagging ACME, Nimbus, Helix as highest priority.

Maria CSM: Draft email (please quick review):
```
Hi <FirstName>,
We're reaching out because we detected a backlog affecting embeddings ingestion between 02:10–03:30 UTC which may have delayed onboarding steps and caused API 503s for some batch uploads. Our team has throttled the reindex job and recovery is underway. We expect service to be fully restored within 1 hour. We're offering a 1hr enablement session and a service credit for affected calls. Reply STOP if you prefer no outreach.
— Maria, Customer Success
```

Olivia (CS Lead): Good. Remove 'Reply STOP' line (legal asked to avoid). Add explicit RCA ETA: 'we will send a technical RCA within 24 hours'. Also add the office-hours signup link placeholder.

Maria CSM: Updated and sent to the segmented lists: A (manual call + exec note), B (templated email + office-hours), C (status page + out-of-band follow-up if persistent). I'll post email copy to the CRM thread and schedule outreach. :email:

Kevin (Infra): Hotfix applied, reindex parallelism set to 2. Observability shows queue draining. I'll keep monitoring and post an update in 20.

Nikhil (SRE): Metrics look stable. No new 5xx spikes for the last 5m. I'll prepare the timeline for the RCA.

Maria CSM: Thanks all. Action items: Olivia — approve credit amount; Sam — join A calls; Anya — enablement doc + office-hours link; Kevin/Nikhil — RCA draft for 24h. I'll send the first wave of emails in 10m. :thumbsup:

Olivia (CS Lead): Approved credit up to $250 for top-tier impacted customers. Send me the list before sending PMs.

Maria CSM: Copy — will share list in CRM thread. Closing loop here, will update if anything changes.
